row: Is your pet doing things that drive you crazy and you don't know what to do about it? Then you came to the right place. Dr. Orion will tell you everything you ever wanted to know, or didn't even think you needed to know, about your pet's behavior. Dr. Orion is a veterinarian and a veterinary behavior specialist (kind of like a pet psychiatrist) and he is here for you.
